news.headline: Freshman Trace Johnson takes over at quarterback
news.summary: Kadin Semonza threw an interception early in the fourth quarter on Saturday, so coach Will Hall sent in true freshman Trace Johnson. Johnson completed 2 of 5 passes for 35 yards and ran the offense while Tulane scored the last 10 points to win.

news.headline: Maurice Turner wins the conference weekly award
news.summary: Turner carried the ball 12 times for 200 yards and two touchdowns in Saturday's 24-21 win over Southern Miss, including the 74-yard run that put Tulane ahead. It is the first weekly honor of his career.

news.headline: Tulane wins the Battle for the Bell 24-21
news.summary: Maurice Turner ran for 200 yards Saturday at Yulman Stadium, and his 74-yard touchdown run with 5:26 left put Tulane ahead. TJ Smith then blocked a Southern Miss field goal to save the win for coach Will Hall against his old team.

news.headline: Vernell Brown is doubtful for the Missouri game
news.summary: Florida's leading receiver hurt his right knee against Ole Miss and is listed as doubtful for Saturday. Bailey Stockton is probable, so the Gators should have him back.

news.headline: Two Florida receivers are questionable for Saturday
news.summary: Vernell Brown III has a mild knee strain and Bailey Stockton has a sore back, and both are listed as questionable at Missouri. Coach Jon Sumrall said neither injury is serious.

news.headline: Jadan Baugh wins the top offensive award in the SEC
news.summary: The conference named Baugh its offensive player of the week after he ran for 142 yards and three touchdowns against Ole Miss. Two more Gators were honored: London Montgomery on special teams and Bryce Lovett on the offensive line.

news.headline: Arch Manning turns up at a middle school game
news.summary: With Texas off this week, Manning went to a middle school football game in Austin on Monday night and spent time with the players. Texas is 4-0 and plays Oklahoma in Dallas on October 10.

news.headline: Texas stays No. 1 in the new rankings
news.summary: The Longhorns kept the top spot in the Associated Press poll after winning 20-17 at Tennessee. They are 4-0 and play Oklahoma in Dallas on October 10.

news.headline: Texas holds off Tennessee 20-17
news.summary: Raleek Brown ran for two touchdowns Saturday in Knoxville, and his 4-yard run with 5:41 left was the one that won it. Colin Simmons had five sacks to tie the Texas record, and the Longhorns are 4-0.

news.headline: Kamara and Miller will carry the ball Monday night
news.summary: Travis Etienne is hurt, so Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller will do most of the running against Atlanta. Coach Kellen Moore said C.J. Donaldson will take the short, tough runs.

news.headline: Trombone Shorty will play at halftime Monday night
news.summary: Trombone Shorty and Orleans Avenue play at halftime, joined by Eric Church, Kirk Franklin, Juvenile, Cyril Neville and Ivan Neville. The Saints will also honor Steve Gleason and Curtis DeLoatch for the blocked punt twenty years ago.

news.headline: Travis Etienne goes on injured reserve
news.summary: The Saints moved Travis Etienne to injured reserve on Thursday because of his hurt hamstring, so he will be out for a while. They signed running back Ulysses Bentley IV to the practice squad, and Alvin Kamara will do most of the running.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher has her best day of the season
news.summary: Peyton had 8 kills in Friday's win over Millersville, more than anyone else on the team. It is the most she has had in a match this year, and she missed on only one of her 14 swings.

news.headline: IUP sweeps California for its 11th win in a row
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks won 25-18, 25-20, 25-23 at home on Friday. Jessica Neiman had 14 kills and Delaney Concannon had 13 kills and 14 digs, and IUP is 12-3 and still unbeaten in the conference.

news.headline: Charlotte Potvin wins the PSAC weekly award
news.summary: Potvin had 28 kills on 46 swings in IUP's two wins last weekend and blocked 10 and a half balls in nine sets. She hit .636 in Friday's win at Slippery Rock, and IUP has now won ten in a row.

news.headline: Gerrit Cole starts Game 1 against Tampa Bay
news.summary: Cole pitches Saturday night in St. Petersburg against the Rays' Drew Rasmussen. He did not pitch against Boston, so he is rested and lined up to open the series.

news.headline: Aaron Judge is not in the lineup for Game 1
news.summary: Judge is still getting over a strained right calf and has not run the bases yet. Ben Rice will bat first and Cody Bellinger second instead.

news.headline: Yankees beat Boston 9-2 and win the series
news.summary: Max Fried pitched well and Cody Bellinger drove in four runs Wednesday night, including a three-run homer. New York won both games against Boston and now plays Tampa Bay on Saturday.

news.headline: Warren Easton wins its first game, 50-0
news.summary: The Eagles shut out Riverdale 50-0 on Thursday in Jefferson for their first win of the year. Warren Easton is now 1-4.

news.headline: Warren Easton loses at Zachary
news.summary: Zachary won 49-28 on Friday night. Warren Easton is 0-4 and plays at Riverdale on Thursday, October 1.

news.headline: Warren Easton falls to Brother Martin
news.summary: Brother Martin scored early and often Friday night and won 56-6. Warren Easton is 0-3 and plays at Zachary next Friday.
